moderators: Not reported in available text.

estimand: Implicit average treatment effects for blocks/building areas exposed to closures versus not (ATE on treated geographic units). Not labeled explicitly.

Adults: no significant differences across 11 categories.

raw_fields.exposure_measure: Perceived—history of interpersonal violence assessed by self-report (Trauma History Questionnaire, 8-item Spanish version) and referral records; all were IPV victims on a waiting list
raw_fields.mental_health_outcomes: PTSD symptoms (CPSS), depression (DSRS), interpersonal problems (IIP-SF), affect regulation difficulties (DERS); all treated as clinical outcomes (no mechanistic outcomes designated)
raw_fields.mediators_mechanisms: Not tested/reported
raw_fields.moderators: Not pre-specified; exploratory post-hoc associations reported (e.g., age, attendance, parental attendance, perceived family support) with change scores; not formal moderation tests
raw_fields.intervention_description: TF-CBT (group adaptation): 12 weekly sessions (1.5–2 h) in two modules; first five TF-CBT components (psychoeducation, relaxation, affect ID/regulation, cognitive coping; no trauma narrative); co-facilitated by trained psychologists; therapist training + supervision detailed. IPT (group adaptation): Two modules (affect regulation; mobilising social network) with IPT-A core elements (psychoeducation, recovery role, interpersonal inventory, role plays, communication analysis, problem-solving). ATBS (active control): Art-therapy–based support (psychoeducation about art as regulation; relaxation; yoga; music/craft/drawing/painting); protocol developed for consistency; usual care in host NGO. All conditions: one preliminary individual session; 12 group sessions; four 1.5–2 h caregiver group sessions in parallel; two clinicians per group.
raw_fields.main_findings: PTSD: Significant decrease over time in total sample (large effect); decreases significant within each arm from T1→T4 and maintained at T5; no Group×Time interaction. Depression: Significant decrease over time (total sample); TF-CBT showed significant T1→T4 and T1→T5 decreases; ATBS and IPT not significant on pairwise T1→T4/T5 tests. Affect regulation: Significant decrease over time; TF-CBT and IPT showed significant T1→T4 and T1→T5 decreases; ATBS not significant. Interpersonal problems: No significant change over time overall; ATBS showed T1→T4 decrease not sustained at T5. Adherence: No significant differences in completion or attendance across arms.
raw_fields.causal_identification_strategy: Randomised allocation of intervention sequences within cities; analysis by three (group) × five (time) mixed repeated-measures ANOVA with Greenhouse–Geisser correction; within-arm paired t-tests (T1–T4; T1–T5); intention-to-treat using last observation carried forward for dropouts; effect sizes: partial η², Cohen’s d; no covariates due to small n
raw_fields.risk_of_bias_raw: Moderate: pilot with small sample; groups not balanced on lifetime trauma count at baseline; assignment tied to city schedule; self-report outcomes; ITT with last observation carried forward; follow-up 8 weeks
raw_fields.strengths_limitations: Strengths—randomised three-arm design; active control; multi-timepoint measurement; therapist training/supervision; caregiver sessions. Limitations—small sample/power; LOCF; self-report only; short follow-up; inability to include covariates; group differences in baseline polyvictimisation; generalisability limited to NGO PRMs.
raw_fields.policy_practice_implications: Low-intensity group interventions are a viable first-phase option for IPV-exposed adolescents on waitlists in high-demand contexts; suggest more systemic caregiver involvement in future implementations.
raw_fields.reviewer_notes: ITT n=67 (participants attending ≥1 session); withdrawals mainly due to safety/transport/scheduling issues; ethics approvals listed; trial registration ISRCTN10290141.
raw_fields.effect_direction_raw: PTSD symptoms ↓ across all arms; sustained at follow-up
raw_fields.statistically_significant_raw: Yes (time effect overall; within-arm T1→T4 and T1→T5 decreases significant for all three arms on PTSD)
raw_fields.estimand: ITT (last observation carried forward for dropouts)
raw_fields.outcome_instrument: CPSS (0–4 per item; total severity), DSRS (0–2 per item; total), IIP-SF (0–4 per item; total), DERS (1–5 per item; total); Spanish/Chilean adaptations reported with Cronbach’s α at each wave
raw_fields.outcome_unit_scale: As above (instrument-specific Likert totals)
raw_fields.exposure_window_raw: Lifetime IPV/trauma history at baseline; not an exposure-variation design during trial
raw_fields.outcome_timepoint: Baseline (T1); Session 6 (T2); Session 7 (T3); Session 12/end (T4); 8-week follow-up (T5)
raw_fields.estimator: Mixed repeated-measures ANOVA (Greenhouse–Geisser); paired t-tests for T1–T4 and T1–T5; effect sizes (partial η²; Cohen’s d)
raw_fields.se_clustering: Assumption checks reported; no cluster-robust SEs; repeated-measures corrections applied (Greenhouse–Geisser)
raw_fields.missing_data_method: Missing outcome data replaced with last available observation for ITT; analyses included adolescents with ≥1 session
